clue.text: Take in sailors or boatmen initially

parts.note: ABs, able-bodied seamen, stand for sailors in crosswords
taken as written

indicators.note: initially asks for only the opening letter of the word boatmen

explanation.surface: Someone is told to welcome aboard either the navy men or, to begin with, the rowers.
explanation.definitionFit: To soak something up or assimilate it is a synonym of taking it in.

clue.text: Add weight to unruly horse, securing second

indicators.note: securing means holding fast, so the horse encloses the second's letter

parts.note: a bolter is a horse that runs off uncontrollably

explanation.surface: Extra weight is added to a wild horse while a second rider holds it.
explanation.definitionFit: To strengthen or support an argument is to reinforce it.

clue.text: Operatic hero ignoring first sex scene

indicators.note: ignoring first means the opening letter of the hero's name is dropped

parts.note: Porgy is the hero of Gershwin's opera Porgy and Bess

explanation.surface: An opera's leading man stays out of the first steamy episode.
explanation.definitionFit: A wild party of indiscriminate sexual activity is an orgiastic scene.

clue.text: Uproar to develop, we hear, over depression on estate

indicators.note: we hear signals a word heard aloud standing for a different spelling

parts.note: to brew is to develop, as a storm brews
a ha-ha is a sunken ditch acting as a fence on a country estate

explanation.surface: A commotion is about to grow over gloom on a housing estate.
explanation.walkthrough: A ha-ha is a sunk fence in a ditch, common on English country estates. 'over' places the first piece above the second in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A noisy fuss or commotion is an uproar.

clue.text: Affected person regrets operation after setback

indicators.note: a setback read literally is a setting back, so the joined pieces are written in the opposite direction

parts.note: to rue something is to regret it, so regrets gives rues

explanation.surface: A show-off feels sorry about undergoing surgery after a disappointment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after setback' turns RUES + OP round to make the answer; 'after' simply joins.
explanation.definitionFit: A poser putting on airs is someone whose manner is affected, a pretentious type.

clue.text: Nuisance around Spain — a former coin there

indicators.note: around means the nuisance surrounds the country's letter

parts.note: a pest is a nuisance
E is Spain's international vehicle code

explanation.surface: Annoyance spreads through Spain over an old piece of money.
explanation.definitionFit: Spain's currency before the euro was this unit, now withdrawn.

clue.text: Reserved in speech giving support

parts.note: spoken means said aloud rather than written
to be for something is to support it

explanation.surface: A shy person nonetheless voices their backing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something already claimed or booked is taken, set aside for someone.

clue.text: A French murder leading to Government's downfall

parts.note: un is French for a
to do in is to murder
G is an abbreviation for government

explanation.surface: A French killing leads to the fall of the administration.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruin, the cause of someone's collapse, is a downfall.

clue.text: "Get thee to a nunnery"?

parts.note: Hamlet's line to Ophelia, read as advice to join a community of nuns or monks living under vows

explanation.definitionFit: A convent houses a community bound by vows, which is a monastic brotherhood or sisterhood.

clue.text: Revolutionary cloaks support soldiers

parts.note: robes are long cloaks
a pier is a supporting pillar
RE, the Royal Engineers, are soldiers

explanation.surface: Rebels' cloaks are propping up the troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Maximilien Robespierre was a leader of the French Revolution's Terror.

clue.text: See 8
Perfectly OK way to describe Tory wets?

explanation.walkthrough: 'Wets' was Thatcher's name for moderate Conservatives; the Right of a party is its Tory wing.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means perfectly fine; read literally it says right-wingers, being Tories, resemble wet showers, wets being moderate Conservatives.

clue.text: Some tub at home?

indicators.note: some here means a portion of the following words, so the letters run inside them

explanation.surface: A question about the domestic tub.
explanation.definitionFit: A tub you wash in at home is exactly a household tub for bathing.

clue.text: Like certain classes — and what teacher doesn't allow in them?

definitions.text: what teacher doesn't allow in them

explanation.definitionFit: The chattering classes are opinionated educated people; talking among pupils is what a teacher forbids during lessons.

clue.text: One-to one contest nonetheless having rounds?

definitions.text: One-to one contest nonetheless having rounds?

parts.words: One-to one contest nonetheless having rounds?
parts.note: a two-candidate election is described as a bout that is not curved yet still has rounds, like a boxing match

explanation.walkthrough: In British elections a contest between only two candidates is called by this name; the clue plays on the first word meaning not curved while a fight has rounds.
explanation.definitionFit: A head-to-head election between just two candidates is a direct, one-on-one contest.

clue.text: I note book is not currently consulted?

parts.note: n. is the abbreviation for note, as in footnote references
to book is to reserve

explanation.surface: Someone notices that a library book is sitting unused on the shelf.
explanation.definitionFit: Something kept back for later use, not in active service, is held aside.

clue.text: See 13
Of current interest regarding Mediterranean area

parts.note: re means regarding
the Levant is the eastern Mediterranean region

explanation.surface: A topical piece about the eastern Mediterranean.
explanation.definitionFit: Something pertinent to present concerns is topical or applicable.

clue.text: Part of Scotland: pub here upset newly-weds

parts.note: an inn is a pub

indicators.note: upset means the word here is knocked over and rearranged

parts.note: brides are women just married

explanation.surface: A pub on a Scottish island where a recently married couple got into a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' rearranges HERE to ERHE, between INN and BRIDES. The answer is the island chain off Scotland's west coast that includes Skye and Mull.
explanation.definitionFit: The island group nearer the mainland, including Skye, Mull and Islay, forms a region of western Scotland.

clue.text: No ruined maid's about to be travelling

indicators.note: ruined means the word maid is wrecked and its letters rearranged

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written
C, circa, means about

explanation.surface: A disgraced servant is about to leave on her journeys.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ruined' rearranges MAID to MADI; 'to be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Wandering peoples who move from place to place lead a roving, travelling life.

clue.text: See 17
Lecturer accepting indication of alternative degree as an opener

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so the lecturer encloses the other pieces

parts.note: a don is a university lecturer
the word or indicates an alternative
MA, Master of Arts, is a degree

explanation.surface: An academic takes a second qualification as a way into a new career.
explanation.definitionFit: A hotel porter stationed at an entrance opens the door for guests.

clue.text: Plane going over almost identical marine debris

indicators.note: going over places the plane above the next piece in this down clue

parts.note: a jet is a plane

indicators.note: almost means the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: same means identical

explanation.surface: An aircraft flies over near-identical rubbish floating at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods thrown overboard that wash ashore are flotsam's partner, debris from the sea.

clue.text: Improved sound quality of expert player in woodwind?

indicators.note: in places the player inside the instrument

parts.note: a reed is a woodwind instrument, or the vibrating part of one
a master is an expert performer

explanation.surface: A virtuoso on the woodwind gives a better sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Recordings that are re-engineered for better audio have had their sound quality enhanced.

clue.text: Painter's year in Indian state

definitions.note: read as 'Painter is', the 's being a contraction

indicators.note: in places the year inside the state

parts.note: Goa is a state on India's west coast

explanation.surface: An artist spends a year in a part of India.
explanation.definitionFit: Francisco de Goya was a celebrated Spanish artist, so a painter.

clue.text: Man with old music recording — Beatles film?

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man
LP is a long-playing vinyl record

explanation.surface: A man with a vintage record of a Beatles movie.
explanation.definitionFit: Help! is the title of the 1965 Beatles comedy movie.

clue.text: Senior politician ends stalemate with resolution about Queen

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters surround the queen's letter
a resolution of a knot or problem is its sorting out, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: R, for Regina, is the abbreviation for queen

explanation.surface: A veteran politician breaks a deadlock with a resolution concerning the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resolution' shuffles ENDS STALEMATE and 'about' puts R inside the result.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-serving, respected politician with influence is a senior figure of public life.

clue.text: See 25
About to participate in trick — it's absolutely hilarious

indicators.note: to participate in means to go into, so the short word goes inside the trick

parts.note: a scam is a trick or swindle
RE, the Latin-derived word meaning concerning, gives about

explanation.surface: Someone agrees to join a con, finding it very funny.
explanation.definitionFit: Something extremely funny is informally called a hoot or riot, a real laugh.

clue.text: Page in binding office work

indicators.note: in places the page inside the binding

parts.note: tying is binding

explanation.surface: A sheet caught in the binding machine at the office.
explanation.definitionFit: Keyboarding letters and documents is classic clerical labour.
